share.groups.label: Shared Session Groups
share.groups.help: Required source publication boundary: publish only sessions in these exact groups. The optional person filter narrows them further. Missing or empty groups publish nothing.

share.involvingProfileId.label: Involving Person
share.involvingProfileId.help: Exact source-local profile ID (including merge aliases), optional for node sharing and required for Gateway publication. Narrows the shared groups to canonical owners or profile participants. Mentions alone, names, and logins do not match.

share.gateway.label: Serve Gateway Session Reads
share.gateway.help: Allow explicitly granted paired devices to read selected groups AND the configured canonical person with the closed publication-read scope. Request relationship filters can only narrow that selection.

gateways.label: Outbound Gateway Sources
gateways.help: Read-only outbound WSS connections with a preprovisioned named identity and singleton publication-read token; Cloudflare Access grants no session authority.

share.gatewayDeviceIds.label: Publication Reader Devices
share.gatewayDeviceIds.help: Exact source-approved paired device IDs. Missing or empty grants no Gateway reads. Devices do not impersonate the selected person.

nodes.label: Paired Node Attribution
nodes.help: Optional display attribution keyed by paired node id. Attribution never grants session access.

nodes.*.controlUiOrigin.label: Source Control UI Origin
nodes.*.controlUiOrigin.help: Optional HTTP(S) origin for Open original, such as https://team.example.com. No credentials, path, query, or fragment. Opens a separate authenticated connection to the source.

nodes.*.controlUiBasePath.label: Source Control UI Base Path
nodes.*.controlUiBasePath.help: Optional source path prefix for Open original, such as /openclaw. Defaults to root. Receiver-owned; never inferred from this Gateway or source session rows. No query, fragment, whitespace, or dot segments.

nodes.*.owner.label: Default Owner
nodes.*.owner.help: Local display owner for unattributed sessions: github:<login> or profile:<profileId>.

nodes.*.linkGitHubIdentities.label: Link GitHub Identities
nodes.*.linkGitHubIdentities.help: Trust this paired node's numeric GitHub account claims for local profile display attribution. Off by default.

recommendedPrompts: Help me plan read-only Session Share access between my source and team Gateways.
Review Session Share settings for unintended exposure without opening chats.
